text:
Nina (People Ops): Thanks for the great all-hands. Quick thread for follow-ups on offsite budgets, desk hoteling, and hybrid "do/don't" items. Keep Qs short and we'll reply inline.
Liam: Two quick ones: can teams pool stipends for a shared speaker/event? and who signs off?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, pooling allowed. Manager + People Ops approval required for pooled stipends > $2k. Use Concur and mark `OPS_OFFSITE_POOL` and attach the attendee & spend plan.
Zoe: Are speaker fees covered if we invite an external trainer for a team retreat?
Nina (People Ops): External trainer fees are covered as an event vendor expense. Ops will route payment via procurement. Tag expense as `EVENT_VENDOR` and include SOW/contract.
Priya: Desk hoteling weirdness: I get "pending" for two days then drop. Any tips?
Nina (People Ops): The portal syncs with calendar reservations. If you're pending, try cancelling any duplicate calendar blocks and rebook. If portal shows full, ping #people-ops with "desk-override" and include date + hub.
Carlos: Quick ask: if we need a quiet room for interviews during an on-site week, can we reserve meeting rooms centrally or is it first-come?
Nina (People Ops): Interview rooms can be reserved via the normal room booking flow; ops keeps a small reserve for interview blocks during all-hands weeks. If you need recurring slots, DM ops and we will carve out time.
Liam: Clarify travel caps: I heard a cap change for Q2 travel spend. True?
Nina (People Ops): No change to core policy. Ops is trialing a regional cap for non-customer discretionary travel in Q2 to manage budgets. Managers will be notified if their team is in trial. Customer-facing travel unaffected.
Asha (CTO): Quick note from leadership: please prioritize in-person customer meetings if the ROI is clear. Ops will fast-track desk & travel approvals for customer visits.
Zoe: If someone needs to work from another country for a week for personal reasons, do we need tax/legal sign-off?
Nina (People Ops): Yes. Any work >7 consecutive days in another country needs manager + people-ops sign-off for tax/immigration checks. Start early.
Priya: Is there a childcare stipend pilot for parents traveling to mandatory offsites?
Nina (People Ops): We're piloting a childcare reimbursement for mandatory offsites; eligible participants will get a note in the invite. Code is `TRAVEL_CHILDCARE_PILOT`. Managers will get details next week.
Carlos: If we rent a van for a regional offsite, can we expense fuel and tolls?
Nina (People Ops): Yes. Use `GROUP_TRANSPORT` and attach vendor receipts. For employee personal-car mileage, use `LOCAL_MILEAGE` rates in Concur.
Liam: Does Redwood cover travel for spouses in hardship cases? Heard exceptions exist.
Nina (People Ops): Exceptions are possible for documented hardship/medical reasons, but require advance ops approval and manager sign-off. Please DM me confidentially.
Zoe: Any change to parking reimbursements for monthly hub passes?
Nina (People Ops): Monthly personal parking is not covered. Short-term parking for company events/meetings is reimbursable under `LOCAL_PARKING`.
Priya: Reimbursements timeline? Been 2 weeks on mine.
Nina (People Ops): Standard is 7-10 business days after manager approval. If it's >10 days, DM me and include the Concur expense ID. Ops audits monthly and will escalate delays.
ops-bot: calendar: Created event "All-Hands Ops: Followups (Offsites & Desks)" and attached Nina's notes.
Carlos: Will you post a short checklist for team leads running offsites?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 9 I'll post a 1-page checklist (budget sign-off, vendor vs reimbursable split, travel codes, accessibility & childcare notes) plus a 4-min Loom by EOD.
Asha (CTO): Appreciate ops running this. Teams, please route offsite budget requests 3 weeks ahead if possible.
Liam: Thanks all! Super helpful.
Nina (People Ops): Thanks everyone 9 will drop the checklist here when ready. DM for urgent approvals.
